defaultSnippets.label: Spawn Herd
defaultSnippets.description: Configures group spawning behavior with min/max herd sizes. Allows running events on the first N entities spawned (initial_event) or after skipping M entities (event). Common for pack animals like wolves or swarm mobs like silverfish.

mob_event_filter.title: Mob Event Filter
mob_event_filter.description: Filter to exclude entities if the event is disabled.

permute_types.title: Permute Types
permute_types.description:
List of randomly choosable permutations of the entity

Properties:
• entity_type (object) = 
• min_guaranteed (int) = 0
• weight (int)

defaultSnippets.label: Spawn PermuteType
defaultSnippets.description: Defines a weighted spawn variant that may be selected when the spawn rule triggers. Configure the entity to spawn and its weight relative to other permutations—higher weights mean that variant spawns more frequently. Enables mob variety like zombie villagers occasionally replacing regular zombies.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: The weight used when comparing other entities that can  spawn within a biome
